description: This file implements the VertexDataManager class, which manages vertex buffer data translation, including static, dynamic, and direct storage, for rendering in a Direct3D context within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: TranslatedAttribute
classes.description: Represents a translated vertex attribute, including its storage, offset, and buffer information.

classes.name: VertexDataManager
classes.description: Manages vertex data translation and buffer management for rendering, supporting static, dynamic, and direct storage modes.

classes.name: VertexBufferBinding
classes.description: Encapsulates a reference to a vertex buffer object, managing its lifecycle and binding state.

methods.name: computeOffset
methods.description: Calculates the byte offset for a vertex attribute based on the start vertex.

methods.name: ClassifyAttributeStorage
methods.description: Determines the storage type (static, dynamic, direct, current value) for a vertex attribute.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the VertexDataManager with a given context.

methods.name: prepareVertexData
methods.description: Prepares vertex attribute data for rendering, handling static, dynamic, direct, and current value attributes.

methods.name: StoreDirectAttrib
methods.description: Stores a direct attribute, setting up buffer and offset information.

methods.name: StoreStaticAttrib
methods.description: Stores static attribute data from a buffer into a static vertex buffer.

methods.name: storeDynamicAttribs
methods.description: Stores dynamic attribute data into streaming buffers.

methods.name: PromoteDynamicAttribs
methods.description: Promotes dynamic attributes to static usage after data transfer.

methods.name: reserveSpaceForAttrib
methods.description: Reserves buffer space for an attribute before data transfer.

methods.name: storeDynamicAttrib
methods.description: Stores a single dynamic attribute's data into streaming buffers.

methods.name: storeCurrentValue
methods.description: Stores current value attributes into buffers.
